status: exact cell-local energy criteria, flux telescoping, and current-time endpoint-ownership obstruction
proof_boundary: This artifact proves the cell-local balance, local contact floors, one-sided threshold, exact internal-flux telescoping, global minimum-threshold criterion, vertex-cover ownership condition, and source ownership audit. It does not prove a cofinal interior anchor registry, any strict Xi local or global bulk upper budget, the corrected finite-main C1 lower bound, Q209, the cofinal descendant theorem, Lambda<=0, PF-infinity, RH, or a Clay-prize conclusion.

source_audit.inherited_boundary: The sources own two cofinal outer endpoints and several finite fixed-time paths, but no stage-uniform current-time anchor set meeting every bounded interior cell.

cell_contact_floor.one_sided: m_(k-1)>0, m_k=0 => T_k=2m_(k-1)^2/h_k; the right-sided analogue is identical

local_criterion.statement: If D_k(t)<T_k(t) for every k, then V_pf(t,x) has no zero on [38,R_j].
local_criterion.input: Each local numerator needs either its two boundary fluxes and energy derivative, or a direct source upper bound for the local bulk.

telescoping.identity: sum_(k=1)^N D_k(t)=d/dt integral_38^R_j E_pf dx+2[J_pf(t,R_j)-J_pf(t,38)]=2 integral_38^R_j B_pf dx=:D_total(t)
telescoping.cancellation: Every internal current J_pf(t,x_k), 1<=k<N, appears once with sign + and once with sign -.

global_minimum_criterion.statement: If T_k(t)>0 for every k and D_total(t)<min_(1<=k<=N) T_k(t), then V_pf(t,x) has no zero on [38,R_j].
global_minimum_criterion.proof: A contact in I_r gives D_r>=T_r, while D_total=sum_k D_k>=D_r because every D_k>=0.
global_minimum_criterion.anchor_condition: T_k>0 exactly when m_(k-1)+m_k>0; hence the certified node set must meet every partition edge.

sum_threshold_guard.false_shortcut: D_total<sum_k T_k does not exclude a contact.
sum_threshold_guard.boundary: This is an exact implication counterexample for the budget logic, not a claimed realization by the Xi field.

anchor_graph.graph: The partition is the path graph on nodes x_0,...,x_N; owned positive margins must form a vertex cover.
anchor_graph.consequence: The two owned outer nodes cover both cells only when N<=2. For N>=3 at least one interior edge has neither endpoint owned; bounded-width localization therefore needs a cofinal interior anchor skeleton.

flux_localization_tradeoff.local_side: Keeping the thresholds cellwise preserves their 1/h_k strength but also keeps the internal fluxes in D_k.
flux_localization_tradeoff.summed_side: Summing cancels every internal flux but compresses all contact information to the weakest threshold min_k T_k.
flux_localization_tradeoff.conclusion: Telescoping is exact bookkeeping, not a substitute for current-time interior endpoint ownership.

ownership_audit.compact: At x=38 and 0<t<=1/5, the compact certificate gives |J_t'(38)|>20577/350 and the inherited margin sqrt(E_pf(t,38))>=m_(L,j)>0.
ownership_audit.dominant: The dominant theorem proves strict normalized Laguerre curvature on tL>=25. The endpoint gate exposes the quantitative margin at x=R_j. Uniformly over a descendant collar, the dominant region shrinks to x=R_j at the bottom time, so it does not populate a bounded-cell skeleton through the old interior.
ownership_audit.oscillatory: For each epsilon>0 the oscillatory theorem gives an existential L_epsilon above c_*+epsilon, c_*=4911678521/1933561194, but no practical L_epsilon or effective cofinal endpoint-margin registry.
ownership_audit.critical_c1: For L>=50 and 0<tL<25, the corrected global C1 remainder satisfies r^2+(r'/L)^2<32000000 exp(-3L/2), but the finite-main lower bound T_L[J]>32000000 exp(-3L/2) remains open.
ownership_audit.finite_phase: The Q208 top and bottom certificates own fixed paths t=1/5 and t=1/1040 on 0<=x<=246. The Q207-to-Q208 transport owns one finite successor on 38<=x<=245.
ownership_audit.conditional_successor: The all-stage phase-cell lemma would transfer margins if delta_j M_(j,k)<d_(j,k) on every cell, but that Xi antecedent is precisely open.

nonpromotion.snapshot: A finite fixed-time phase chain cannot be reused as a current-time cofinal anchor registry.
nonpromotion.positivity: Qualitative strict positivity with an ineffective height does not provide the effective positive m_i needed by the minimum-threshold criterion.
nonpromotion.partition: Choosing more cells improves 1/h_k only after supplying more certified anchors; partition refinement alone proves nothing pointwise.

exact.route_decision: Retain the local and globally telescoped criteria as exact conditional lemmas, but park the energy-localization route. The audited sources do not supply a cofinal current-time interior anchor vertex cover, and attempting to transport one reintroduces the open all-j phase-cell estimate. Return to the critical contact-normal C1 arithmetic target.
exact.open_handoff: Prove the corrected finite-main inequality T_L[J]>32000000 exp(-3L/2) for L>=50 and 0<tL<25, with cutoff transitions retained. First derive a cutoff-stable phase/amplitude decomposition of T_L[J] and identify the smallest signed cancellation statement that would force the lower bound; do not divide by the unknown first-jet norm.
